entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Old giant soldier and Marshal of the kentsu of Madara, loved by his troops, killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Shapeshifter who replaced Warbeard, ordered by Ramses Overdark to infiltrate the kentsu.
